ledger.x: 1867: the North German Confederation takes effect under Prussian leadership.
4 August 1870: German armies invade north-eastern France.
2 September 1870: Napoleon III surrenders at Sedan.
September 1870: the war goes on against the Government of National Defence.
December 1870: the Confederation becomes the German Empire while the war is still on.
December 1870: the Confederation is renamed German Empire.

wars.name: Franco-Prussian War
wars.outcome: German victory: the war ran from 19 July 1870 to 28 January 1871; the German states proclaimed their union as the German Empire; France ceded most of Alsace and parts of Lorraine by the Treaty of Frankfurt (10 May 1871).

certainty.note: Prussia's 1866 annexations were made into provinces with provincial boundaries; the frontier with the southern states along the Main is a state boundary.
